CA.rationale: Content (red at candidate node) is explicitly bound to a processing/origin attribute (command_estimate) at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (identified red coordinates), an organization/presentation attribute (pattern across coordinates), and a separate status/origin attribute are explicitly present for the same referent/time.

A.rationale: A processing/origin attribute (command_estimate/feedback_through) is explicitly attached to the content's representation at the candidate referent, linking processing condition to content presentation.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies represented content (color labels red/blue) bound to coordinate sets at named referents.

D.rationale: Content identification (red coordinates) is separately attributed an origin/status field for the same referent/time, distinguishing content from its status/organization.

O.rationale: The report states how contents are presented across named nodes (coordinate patterns) and records origin/representation metadata, indicating organization/presentation/access.
